comparator.description: The careful-English arm fixes referent number exactly as the row dictates — 'that one person/entity' / 'those two or more people/entities' — leaving identity open, with verb morphology identical across arms because singular they takes ordinary plural agreement. Every item keeps one singular and one plural antecedent candidate semantically live.

attempt.estimand: Difference in comprehension accuracy between the marked pronouns they-one/they-many and the row's dictated careful-English number phrasing, on operational consequence questions (approval-count and ownership-contact) over 128 items where one singular and one plural antecedent are both live, balanced across intended number, antecedent order, subject kind and consequence type, the two number strata separate and never pooled. Attested successor to the retracted point-rule-era original 92b77fdc on this row; the bare-they arm and the five false-inference audit rates are separate follow-up filings, not part of this estimand.
